summary: This directory provides utilities for handling, parsing, and verifying binary data structures within the application. It serves as a centralized location for low-level data manipulation logic that requires shared access across different modules.
responsibilities: Encoding and decoding binary data formats
Providing helper functions for byte-level operations
relationships: Binary data utilities act as the foundation for data validation routines.
Data encoding modules rely on low-level byte operations to transform raw input into structured binary formats.
designDecisions: Centralized shared logic to ensure consistent binary handling across the codebase
Comprehensive test coverage for binary operations to prevent data corruption
